name: Shanghai Material Trading Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Material Trading Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the domestic and international commerce of a diverse range of products. Its trading activities encompass metallic and mineral commodities, industrial chemicals and light raw materials, building supplies, timber, automobiles and their parts, mechanical and electrical equipment, various fuels, and knitted textile goods. Beyond these core commercial operations, the company also provides extensive warehousing services, expert information consulting, and technical support. Additionally, it actively participates in global import and export transactions. Founded in 1993 and based in Shanghai, China, the organization previously operated under the name Shanghai Material Trading Center Co., Ltd.
